=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1510-1520 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root guard was not updated to match the template, leaving the files out of parity and causing `test_template_parity` to fail.
  WHY: CI reports that the root retains the old ordering while the template has the new structure; the two copies can make different decisions for the same command.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1513-1517 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root guard asks on vetted literal-ID read loops before the loop validator can approve them.
  WHY: The early `_unquoted_gh_api_expansion` check returns `ask` for loop-counter expansions, so the literal-ID loop tests receive `ask` instead of `allow` or `None`.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1513-1531 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The template change does not exempt the literal-ID loop counter from the unquoted-expansion ask.
  WHY: The change reorders checks but does not skip the loop counter variable; the guard still asks for vetted literal-ID loops, including when the loop body has a read-only pipe that `_is_approvable_read_loop` rejects.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1519-1525 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The trailing `gh api` expansion check misses multiline loops when `done` is preceded by a newline rather than a semicolon.
  WHY: The regex requires a literal semicolon before `done`, so an unquoted expansion in a trailing `gh api` call can bypass the ask and reach Bash word-splitting.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:Line 748, in Collector.lineage | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: `item.get("number") == own_number` fails to exclude the current issue when `own_number` is a string.
  WHY: The GitHub API returns an integer, so strict equality with a string is false and the issue can appear in its own lineage.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:lines 465, 477 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: No defect reported: catching `RecursionError` in `_load_json_lenient` is a correct defensive improvement.
  WHY: The change prevents excessively nested JSON from crashing the collector; the reviewer says the new test confirms the behavior.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:lines 462-478 — `_load_json_lenient` now catches `RecursionError` in addition to `ValueError` | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: No defect reported: catching `RecursionError` in `_load_json_lenient` is a correct fix.
  WHY: The reviewer says this prevents deeply nested JSON from crashing the collector and is verified by the new test.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: "Exempt the literal-ID loop counter from the gh api unquoted-expansion ask"

  confidence=[5]

- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:lines 1519-1524 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The trailing `gh api` expansion regex requires a literal semicolon before `done` and misses newline-delimited loop endings.
  WHY: A trailing unquoted expansion after such a loop can bypass the prompt guard and word-split into arbitrary arguments or flags.
- tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:Line 1017, test_template_parity | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root hook and template copy are out of parity.
  WHY: `test_template_parity` fails, and the root hook still asks on literal-ID loop expansions before loop validation.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:Line 748, in Collector.lineage | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `item.get("number") == own_number` fails to exclude the current issue when `own_number` is a string.
  WHY: The API returns an integer, so the equality evaluates false and the issue can appear in its own lineage.
- Requirement: The workflow-templates twin stays byte-identical to `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py`.
  Expected change site: `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` and `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py`
  Evidence of absence: LAST RUN DIFF modified `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` at lines 1516-1528 but did not update `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py`. The two files remain diverged, causing `test_template_parity` to fail in the tests-hooks-and-orchestrator CI check run.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: Exempt the literal-ID loop counter from the gh api unquoted-expansion ask so vetted read loops are approved.
  Expected change site: `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` and `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py`
  Evidence of absence: Neither hook file implements a loop-counter variable exemption mechanism. In `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py`, `_unquoted_gh_api_expansion` still triggers unconditionally at line 1513 before `_is_approvable_read_loop` can execute, causing 11 loop test failures in CI. In `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py`, a coarse loop-header regex is used instead of verifying that the expanded variable matches the loop counter.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  WHY: The counter is still flagged by `_unquoted_gh_api_expansion`, so the vetted loop returns `ask`.

  PROBLEM: The root and template guard copies are not byte-identical.
  WHY: They can make different decisions for the same command, causing inconsistent allow/ask decisions across the source and consumer repos.

  Evidence of absence: The last run's diff touches `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` (22 lines changed) but does not touch `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` at all. The CI failure log shows `test_template_parity` fails with the root retaining the old check at line 1513-1517 while the template has the new check after the writes block.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER

- Requirement: "Exempt the literal-ID loop counter from the gh api unquoted-expansion ask" (commit message of the most recent commit, also the stated goal of the in-flight fix in the PR description's "Workflow file size limit" section).
  Expected change site: A new `_literal_loop_counter(command)` helper in both `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` and `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py`, used to skip the loop counter when `_unquoted_gh_api_expansion` scans arguments.

There is no `_literal_loop_counter` function defined or called in either the root or the template (the grep for `_literal_loop_counter` returns no matches).   ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
